posts.raw_content:
On the surface it’s easy to see this as socialism. If you dig deeper, you will see this is actually an effort to fight fire with fire and *save* us from permanent socialism/communism. 

**REASON ONE** — Most importantly this “$5k dollars to every American adult if republicans win the house and senate” helps republicans win elections and save America from invasion. Immigration is the most important issue, not spending.

Like it or not the USA has been a welfare state for the last century. No candidate who runs for office promising to take away your money ever wins.  You cannot compete with Democrats saying “we want to give you money” by saying “we do NOT want to give you money.” 

**REASON TWO** — This type of government “handout” is an improvement over the status quo of the welfare state. This gives money only to *citizens* while the current welfare state gives half of it to illegals.

**REASON THREE** — Americans are not paying for this “handout.”
This handout is funded entirely by tariff revenue. This is foreigners paying money directly to Americans for the privilege of using our markets.

**REASON FOUR** — Since this “handout” comes from tariff revenue, it’s more analogous to a company paying dividends to a stockholder. We are not printing money. It will not cause inflation. This is a way of Trump saying *I acknowledge my tariff policy has resulted in a marginal increase in consumer prices. Here is some of the money back to help ease that pain.”*

**REASON FIVE** — This gives Americans back their own money which foreign companies have been effectively stealing from us with ratty trade gimmicks. If we had no Trump tariff policies at all, China and other countries would just be ripping us off and the $5,000 dollars you are going to get next year would effectively just go to China.

**REASON SIX** —DeSantis is against it, so it’s automatically good. 

In an ideal world, with a country filled with high IQ white Christians, we wouldn’t need to do this. In modern America, a welfare state that had open borders for the last 50 years, this “handout” becomes a brilliant ploy that only Trump could pull off, because he is America First and not wedded to worship of “muh free market.”
